review_type: isolated primary-source-only focused setup authority/applicability review
question: Can the later FFG revised rulebook simultaneous chosen-alien reveal clarify the original2008 CE01 two-flare/select-one setup while retaining the original50 aliens and original base scope?

decision.compatible_later_evidence: Supported. The revised Advanced Setup retains the mechanically relevant two-flare/select-one procedure and explicitly supplies the simultaneous chosen-sheet reveal that original setup does not state.
decision.narrow_attributed_clarification: Justified as a clearly identified later publisher instruction that can inform an editorial clarification for the original procedure, subject to an explicit source/scope policy permitting this supplemental evidence. This is an applicability judgment, not proof of the historical intent of the 2008 text.
decision.established_retroactive_authority: Not established in the reviewed sources. Current publisher hosting, the CE01 filename, shared mechanics, and revised credits do not themselves say that this sentence corrects or governs every original2008 printing.
decision.adoption_status: No adoption, guide edit, human interpretation authorization, publication approval, or expansion of the frozen source union is presumed or performed.

independent_checks: Opened official FFG product page and followed its Core Rulebook link with web tool; link resolved to the supplied revised URL and a 20-page PDF.
Separately fetched the official product HTML and verified both exact rulebook and FAQ URLs occur in it.
Separately fetched the official rulebook PDF; 5,707,151 bytes and SHA256 exactly match the provided capture.
Captured current FAQ bytes are identical to the original supplied applicable FAQ PDF, SHA256 2ca0cd15241d3b94333bb11dfa0d74ba8ce28ebb91dd1dfc4c7e710bad919137.
limits: The page is current support evidence, not an explicit retroactive applicability notice.
The product-page prose says fifty species, while the linked revised PDF components list 51; generic product prose therefore does not resolve edition applicability.

The revised PDF credits contain a 2018 copyright and Revised Edition credits; its metadata creation date is 2023-10-11 and the current URL directory is 2026/09. These do not establish the first publication date of the reveal sentence.

comparison.original_explicit: Original rulebook p3 lists 50 alien sheets and 50 flare cards, with a separately listed alternate Filch flare.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p3 lists 51 alien sheets, 51 flare cards, an alternate Filch flare, 34 Cosmic Combo cards and a Quick-Start Guide.
comparison.classification: Edition/component difference; no permission to add the 51st alien or its flare to original scope.

comparison.original_explicit: Original p6 step4: shuffle flares, deal two to each player, take matching alien sheets, examine them secretly, choose one, place it facedown, return the other to the box.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p16 Advanced Setup step4: deal two flares facedown to each player, take the matching sheets, choose one, return the other, then reveal chosen sheets simultaneously.
comparison.classification: Shared two-flare/select-one core is explicit in both. Original secret selection and temporary facedown placement are explicit. Exact reveal timing and simultaneity are explicit only in the later passage.

comparison.original_explicit: Original p6 moves directly from step4 alien selection to step5 flare preparation, step6 eight-card hands, and step7 first player, without a reveal instruction.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p16 places the simultaneous reveal at the end of Advanced Setup step4, before step5 cosmic-deck preparation and subsequent starting hands.
comparison.classification: A reveal between completed private selection and deck preparation is directly supported by the later procedure. It is not explicitly located there by original p6.

comparison.original_explicit: Original p6 step5 uses both flares dealt to every player, including the flares for aliens not chosen, and adds random flares to reach ten for fewer than five players. It permits learning games without flares.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p16 step5 likewise collects dealt flares and randomly fills to ten, then mixes them with encounter/reinforcement/artifact cards.
comparison.classification: Strong procedural continuity. Revealing an alien does not entitle its player to retain that flare or remove the unchosen flare.

comparison.original_explicit: Original p14 explicitly describes a variant in which chosen sheets remain facedown after selection, powers cannot be used while facedown, and a player may reveal at any time to use the power.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p16 also presents Hidden Powers separately and explicitly suppresses the ordinary setup reveal.
comparison.classification: Original variant context supports an inference that ordinary alien identity is revealed for play. It does not independently specify simultaneous reveal or the exact point within setup. Variant rules are contextual evidence only and are not adopted.

comparison.original_explicit: The two-flare selection and flare mixing are normal original p6 setup, with a learning-game omission note.
comparison.revised_explicit: Revised p5 default selection uses Cosmic Combos and its deck omits flares; p16 Advanced Setup replaces revised steps4 and5. Revised p5 also gives the youngest player the first turn in a first game.
comparison.classification: The relevant later match is Advanced Setup, not wholesale revised default setup. Relabeling original normal setup as an advanced variant, importing Cosmic Combos, changing default flaring or first-player selection is unsupported by this focused adoption.

explicit: FFG currently links the revised publisher PDF as the core rulebook.
The later Advanced Setup explicitly commands simultaneous chosen-sheet reveal after choosing and returning the unused sheet.
The original rulebook does not explicitly command that simultaneous setup reveal.
inferred: Temporary original facedown placement prevents disclosure while players are choosing; an eventual ordinary reveal is consistent with the original Hidden Powers variant contrast. Its exact timing is not stated by the original.

Because the same core selection and ten-flare deck preparation surround the later sentence, using that sentence as a clarification for original components is mechanically plausible. The analysis does not prove what the 2008 designers intended.
compatible: Keep the original 50 alien sheets and their original flare pool; make private selections exactly as original p6 says; once all choices are complete, a later-source-attributed simultaneous reveal can be inserted before original step5.
This one reveal instruction does not require the revised 51st alien, Cosmic Combos, an expansion, Technology or another variant.
not_established: No reviewed statement labels the reveal sentence a 2008 erratum or explicitly extends it to every 2008 printing.
No exact reveal timing or simultaneity can be cited to original p6 alone.
No blanket precedence of the revised rulebook over original2008 rules has been demonstrated.
No new all-50 alien interaction or special setup audit has been completed here.
authority_analysis.faq_check: The original applicable FAQ is byte-identical to the current publisher FAQ capture. Its errata section was read in bounded ranges; targeted searches of the complete FAQ for setup, reveal, revision/revised, edition and errata did not locate a chosen-alien simultaneous setup reveal ruling or edition-bridging statement. This was a focused search and errata read, not a full 22-page FAQ audit.

stronger_provenance_needed.for_exact_later_attribution: No additional provenance is needed to establish that the later publisher rulebook says this; official linking and a live byte-for-byte match are established. A local editorial/source-scope decision is still required before using it in a frozen original2008 guide.
stronger_provenance_needed.for_unqualified_original2008_rule_or_off: Yes. Obtain an official FFG correction, edition applicability notice, dated primary-source answer, or comparable publisher statement explicitly tying this reveal instruction to original2008 CE01. Another current download or a community interpretation would not fill that authority gap.

conditional_adoption.candidate_exact_attribution: The later FFG revised rulebook (p16, Advanced Setup step4) says: “Then, all players reveal their chosen sheet simultaneously.” Applying that timing here is a later-source clarification of the original two-flare selection procedure; the 2008 setup does not state it explicitly.
conditional_adoption.candidate_status: Review wording only; no guide change authored.
necessary_scope_manifest_changes_if_adop: Retain original2008 CE01 and the original50 alien/component universe as the target scope; retain existing original source hashes and original rules as the baseline.

Add the pinned revised PDF as supplemental later evidence for one specifically enumerated setup claim, with exact p16 Advanced Setup step4 locator, support URL, live fetch hash and retrieval evidence. Preserve surrounding step5 as comparison context rather than broadly importing the page.

Record its evidence class as an explicit later publisher instruction with inferred compatibility, not as an established retroactive erratum. State the original omission and the conditional editorial decision.

Explicitly exclude the revised 51st alien and flare, Cosmic Combo and Quick-Start components, revised default setup/flaring/first-player choice, changed play rules, variants, expansion rules, and all other revised content from the adopted rule scope.

Update affected claim-level citations and source-coverage records if the local workflow adopts this claim, without rewriting prior frozen manifests or retroactively representing earlier review receipts as having read the new source.

Recheck the changed setup explanation for ordering: complete private selections and return unused sheets, reveal simultaneously, mix both dealt flares per player and fill to ten, then deal original starting hands and use original first-player selection. No new full50 power audit or publication approval is supplied by this focused review.

unresolved_uncertainty: Whether FFG intended this sentence to clarify an omission in the original printing or to prescribe revised-edition behavior is not explicitly stated in the sources reviewed.
The original rulebook supports eventual ordinary disclosure contextually, but its precise moment and simultaneity remain unstated.
Whether a particular guide workflow permits an attributed later-edition clarification within original scope depends on a source-adoption decision outside this review; no such decision is presumed.
